description: Ministry of Water Supply and Estate Infrastructure Development - Amended Extra Gazette No.2343/29, Dated 2nd August 2023, in Respect of the Sewerage Lariff With Effect From 01st August 2023.
categorisation: This gazette contains a legal notice under Section 84 of the National Water Supply and Drainage Board Law No. 02 of 1974, revising sewerage service tariffs. It establishes new regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements for pricing structures, making it a Legal/Regulatory gazette. While it includes a minister's name and title, it does not contain detailed portfolio responsibilities or government structural changes that would qualify it as a government-related type (1-3).
